description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Sustainability Manager**
--------------------------

**Industry: Food Manufacturing**

### **Role Purpose**

Bakery Brera is an artisanal bakery and café with a growing local and international customer base. As the Company continues to grow, we are strengthening our food manufacturing capabilities through improved **sustainable production, productivity, innovation, quality and resource efficiency** .

The Sustainability Manager will lead the development and implementation of sustainable food manufacturing practices, production improvement initiatives and process optimisation. The role will work closely with Management, Kitchen, Production and Front-of-House teams, as well as suppliers and industry partners, to achieve measurable improvements in productivity, resource efficiency, food waste reduction and product quality.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sustainable Food Manufacturing and Resource Efficiency**

* Develop and implement sustainable food manufacturing practices to reduce food waste, ingredient wastage, packaging waste and unnecessary resource consumption.

* Assess existing production practices and identify opportunities to improve resource utilisation, production efficiency and sustainability performance.

* Monitor the utilisation of ingredients, packaging and production resources to identify areas for improvement.

* Support the development of practical sustainability initiatives that balance environmental impact, operational feasibility and cost efficiency.

* Track the effectiveness of sustainability initiatives using appropriate performance indicators.

**2. Process Innovation & Technology Adoption**

* Identify suitable digital tools, technologies or improved working methods that may enhance production efficiency, data visibility or resource management.

* Support the evaluation and implementation of appropriate technology or process solutions within bakery manufacturing operations.

* Assess how new tools or technologies may improve productivity, process consistency, monitoring and resource utilisation.

* Support the development and implementation of improved workflows following the introduction of new tools or processes.

* Monitor operational outcomes following implementation and recommend further improvements where appropriate.

**3. Production Data Analysis & Performance Management**

* Collect and analyse production information relating to yield, wastage, ingredient utilisation, labour productivity, production costs and resource consumption.

* Develop basic production KPIs and performance indicators to monitor operational and sustainability performance.

* Identify trends, variances and performance gaps from production data.

* Translate operational data into actionable insights and improvement recommendations for Management.

* Prepare operational and technical reports to communicate findings, project progress and improvement outcomes.

* Progressively develop capability in using data-driven analysis to support operational decision making.

**4. Green Manufacturing & Sustainable Packaging**

* Identify opportunities to improve energy, utility, material and resource efficiency within bakery production.

* Review existing packaging materials and processes and identify sustainable, cost-effective and operationally suitable alternatives.

* Work with suppliers and relevant partners to evaluate sustainable materials, packaging solutions and production practices.

* Assess proposed sustainability solutions based on cost, operational practicality, resource efficiency and environmental considerations.

* Support the implementation and monitoring of selected green manufacturing and sustainable packaging initiatives.

**5. ⁠Process Innovation & Technology Adoption**

* Identify suitable digital tools, technologies or improved working methods that may enhance production efficiency, data visibility or resource management.

* Support the evaluation and implementation of appropriate technology or process solutions within bakery manufacturing operations.

* Assess how new tools or technologies may improve productivity, process consistency, monitoring and resource utilisation.

* Support the development and implementation of improved workflows following the introduction of new tools or processes.

* Monitor operational outcomes following implementation and recommend further improvements where appropriate.

⁠

**6. Improvement Project & Stakeholder Management**

* Support and progressively take ownership of cross-functional sustainability and production improvement projects.

* Develop basic project plans, implementation timelines and progress updates for assigned initiatives.

* Coordinate with Production, Kitchen, Front-of-House, Management, suppliers and external partners during project implementation.

* Communicate project findings, recommendations and outcomes to relevant stakeholders.

* Support the adoption of new SOPs, processes and sustainability practices through stakeholder engagement and change implementation.

**7.⁠ ⁠Staff Capability & Continuous Improvement Culture**

* Conduct staff sessions on sustainability, production efficiency, quality, waste reduction and responsible resource utilisation.

* Support staff adoption of new processes, SOPs and sustainability practices.

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational discipline and resource efficiency.

* Share project findings and lessons learned to support continuous organisational improvement.

  

We are a small boutique artisanal bakery in the heartlands that serving fresh authentic European breads and pastries. We aim to bring quality and healthy bakes to the community and to re-define bread eating culture in Singapore. We take pride to bake and to serve with love. We believe in sustainability and to partner closely as one fun bread lover community.

Headquartered in Tokyo, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) is a leading global financial institution and a core member of Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMBC Group). We work closely as one SMBC Group to offer personal, corporate and investment banking services to meet the needs of our customers.

With sustainability embedded within our strategy and operations, we are committed to creating a society in which today’s generation can enjoy economic prosperity and well-being and pass it on to future generations.

title: Environmental Control Officer (ECO)
description:
**Job Description**  
As an Environmental Control Officer (ECO), you will support clients in the implementation, management, and monitoring of environmental health and compliance requirements across construction projects. The role involves ensuring compliance with applicable environmental regulations, promoting environmental best practices, and supporting project teams in maintaining a safe and environmentally responsible worksite.

The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing environmental control measures, conducting inspections and audits, coordinating with regulatory authorities, and driving environmental awareness initiatives to ensure compliance with statutory and client requirements.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Perform duties as a registered Environmental Control Officer (ECO) for construction projects in accordance with applicable regulations.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable environmental and statutory requirements imposed by regulatory authorities and clients.
* Liaise with consultants, contractors, clients, and relevant authorities including the National Environment Agency (NEA), Ministry of Manpower (MOM), Public Utilities Board (PUB), National Parks Board (NParks), and other stakeholders on environmental matters.
* Monitor and assess environmental aspects of site operations, including air quality, noise levels, water quality, environmental control measures (ECM), waste management, housekeeping, pest control, and sanitation practices.
* Conduct routine environmental inspections and audits to identify areas of non-compliance and opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend and implement reasonably practicable measures to mitigate environmental risks and prevent pollution incidents.
* Manage and monitor the storage, handling, and usage of hazardous substances in accordance with applicable regulations and best practices.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring programmes and maintain records of inspections, audits, monitoring results, and corrective actions.
* Investigate environmental incidents, complaints, and non-conformances, and recommend corrective and preventive measures.
* Organise and conduct environmental health awareness programmes, inductions, toolbox talks, and training sessions for site personnel.
* Prepare environmental reports and compile data for monthly submissions and management review.
* Maintain all environmental compliance documentation in accordance with client and regulatory requirements.
* Support clients in achieving project-specific environmental objectives and sustainability initiatives where required.
* Perform other environmental-related duties and ad hoc assignments as required by the Client.

**Job Requirements**

* Must be registered with the National Environment Agency (NEA) as an Environmental Control Officer (ECO).
* Minimum 2 to 3 years of relevant experience in environmental management within the construction industry.
* Good knowledge of Singapore environmental regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience liaising with regulatory authorities such as NEA, MOM, PUB, and NParks.
* Strong understanding of environmental monitoring, waste management, pollution control, housekeeping, sanitation, and hazardous substance management.
* Experience conducting environmental inspections, audits, investigations, and training programmes.
* Strong observation, analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and documentation management.

**Employment Type:** Contract (duration to be determined based on Client requirements), with extension or renewal subject to the Client’s requirements and project needs.
